profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microchip Technology Inc.
profile.summary: Experienced Embedded Software Engineer with 3 years of hand‑on experience in Wi‑Fi firmware development and Linux Kernel support. Proficient in C programming and embedded communication protocols. Possess qualities of a dedicated team member and empathetic listener with confident speaking abilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and develop demo applications for Wi‑Fi modules to showcase firmware capabilities and key features to customers, enabling effective product evaluation and integration.
• Implement AT command support at the application layer of Wi‑Fi module firmware, enhancing module configurability and ease of use.
• Develop and integrate software modules within the MPLAB Harmony framework, contributing to both 32‑bit and 8‑bit microcontroller platforms, and utilizing their respective automation and configuration scripting environments to support Wi‑Fi firmware functionality and streamline cross‑platform driver development.
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Python (Programming Language) and +1 skill

positions.title: Research Aide
positions.description:
• Worked with electronic, software and mechanical systems to develop hardware for testing of spacecraft and subsystems.
• Automatic mass balancing system for Attitude Determination and Control System (ADCS) testbed that simulates almost zero gravity using IMU sensor and microcontroller in C++ coding language.

company.name: Interplanetary Initiative at Arizona State University

positions.title: Associate Engineer - Software
positions.description:
• Performed back‑end programming of COSEC ACTA’s features using C and established communication link between main appli‑
cation (containing actual data) and webpage (developed using HTML, Jquery and CSS) by Goahead web server.
• Worked on bug fixing and testing features of their devices.
• Used JIRA agile development software to create and track projects/issues.

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University

projects.title: Thread programming and HCSR04 driver in Zephyr RTOS
projects.description: • Developed a HCSR04 sensor driver module in Zephyr RTOS with API functions to trigger a new measurement of distance, saving the distance measure and a timeout parameter. The application accepted commands like starting the sensors and printing the distance measure through shell module.

projects.title: Designing a FPGA accelerator
projects.description: •	Designed Modified Gram-Schmidt Method for QR factorization on an FPGA board with focus on algorithm modelling, architectural design and data type optimization. Designed and synthesized on target using MATLAB Simulink HDL Coder and Xilinx Vivado respectively. Design target was to gain maximum computational throughput.
